title: 1.3 million people will live here. Today it is one tent.
intro: A wide, empty meadow. One white tent, nothing else to the horizon. The claim comes at once: 1.3 million people will live here. Cut: the same land from three kilometres up, 898 villages drawn over it, every one of them empty. Cut back: one tent. The clock: Day 1 of 5,423. Flashes of what this one day will take: a river that is a ditch, a tree that fails three times, a storm on its way. One person, one day, an empty screen. Does a city start here, or does it end here?
